mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair B12 absorption and utilization, while cyanocobalamin is generally well-tolerated but may have reduced efficacy in the setting of amphotericin B-induced renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and B12 levels during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider electrolyte supplementation; assess B12 effectiveness in addressing deficiency during amphotericin B therapy.
